topic: Antenna Aperture Size Trade-Offs Between LEO and GEO Satellites
consensus_response: The choice between LEO and GEO satellites for CMOS-based ground terminals involves balancing gain, portability, and interference.  LEO offers smaller antennas for higher gain and portability, while GEO enjoys larger antennas for better coverage and higher data rates.  The trade-off depends on the application. For example, LEO excels in mobile internet and emergency communication, while GEO is ideal for weather forecasting.
